title: NFL Schedule 2026: Jets won’t play any international games

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL Schedule 2026: Jets won’t play any international games
sources.description: The NFL releases its full regular season schedule tomorrow night. The league is, however, announcing several marquee games ahead of the official release. Today the NFL announced its international games for 2026. The Jets will be stateside for their 17 games. If recent history is any indication, the Jets avoiding an international game might not […]
